repo.name: tc7200u-research
repo.purpose: Preserve TC7200U BCM3383 OpenWrt bring-up notes, logs, captures, images, reverse output, patch copies, and the current wrapper-only delivery workflow.

layout.records: Single data bucket for notes, logs, captures, generated output, snapshots, binaries, reverse output, network scans, and backups.
layout.records/runtime-probes: Runtime experiment notes and probe analysis.
layout.records/generated: Manifests, state captures, hashes, generated measurements, and deep-mine output.
layout.records/reverse: Reverse-engineering projects, labels, scripts, and extracted ProgramStore material.
layout.docs: Curated status, workflow, path, and topic docs.
layout.patches: OpenWrt patch copies and experiment patch sets.
layout.scripts: Wrapper-only operational scripts plus host helpers.

execution_policy.script_runner: User runs scripts manually to save tokens.
execution_policy.ai_role: AI provides the exact prompts or commands to run and expected verification checks.

wrap: Build the raw initramfs in the OpenWrt tree outside this repo.
Use --preserve-from ./records/artifacts/rescue/tc7200-stage2-console-good.bin --fresh-header when staying aligned with the current template policy.
Confirm the wrapper output contains size_ok=True before serving it to CFE/TFTP.

environment.RESEARCH: Optional wrapper override for repo path; default is ~/tc7200u-research.
environment.RECORDS_DIR: Optional wrapper override for records path; default is $RESEARCH/records.
environment.RESEARCH_BUILDS_DIR: Optional wrapper override for wrapper log path; default is $RECORDS_DIR/logs/builds.
environment.TC7200U_PRESERVE_FROM_IMAGE: Optional default preserve-from image path for wrapper runs.
environment.TC7200U_WRAP_LOAD_ADDR: Optional default load address override for wrapper runs.

git.branch_policy: Main-repo-only by default. Stay in \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\mgta29\tc7200u-research on main/origin/main; do not create or switch branches unless the user explicitly asks.
git.before_work: Run git status --short --branch and preserve existing dirty worktree content.
git.moves: Use git mv for tracked path moves when practical.
git.verification: Run relevant wrapper checks, JSON validation, markdown/path audits, and git diff --check before committing.
git.commit: After verified work, run git add -A and create a local commit with a direct research-focused message.
git.push: Never push unless the user explicitly asks for a push.
git.worktree_policy: Do not use git worktree, side trees, side clones, or separate scratch repositories unless the user explicitly asks.

working: A825 ProgramStore wrapping is handled by scripts/programstore.sh and internally verifies size_ok=True.
current_focus.blocker: BCM3383 GENET at 0x12c00000 probes and queues TX frames, but TDMA does not consume descriptors and RX remains zero.
current_focus.next_action: Continue kernel-side GENET descriptor width, DMA window, and clock/reset probing before switch integration.

rules.log_retention: NO DELETING OLD LOGS. Preserve existing logs and create new dated logs or records instead of overwriting or removing prior evidence.
rules.single_repo_policy: Use only the main tc7200u-research repository: local \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\mgta29\tc7200u-research and online origin/main. Do not create side repositories, side clones, alternate trees, worktrees, or branch-based workflows unless the user explicitly asks.
